camel_example: aliyun esa UpdateWaitingRoomRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --RuleEnable on --Rule 'http.request.uri.path.file_name_eq_jpg' --RuleName test1 --WaitingRoomRuleId 89877398390000
description_en: Updates the waiting room bypass rule configuration for a specified site
description_zh: 更新指定站点的等候室绕过规则配置
kebab_example: aliyun esa update-waiting-room-rule --site-id 1234560000 --waiting-room-rule-id 89877398390000 --rule-name test1 --rule-enable on --rule http.request.uri.path.file_name_eq_jpg --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateWaitingRoomRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the waiting room bypass rule to update. You can obtain this ID after creating a rule by calling CreateWaitingRoomRule, or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 要更新的等候室绕过规则ID，可通过 CreateWaitingRoomRule 创建后获取或通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html接口获取
parameters.name: waiting_room_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content. A conditional expression is used to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

For the complete syntax of rule expressions, refer to
<props="china">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props>
<props="intl">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props>
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

规则表达式完整语法参考
<props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/zh/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props>
<props="intl">https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/edge-security-acceleration/esa/user-guide/work-with-rules-engine/</props>
parameters.name: rule
